_doc: One arm = one formulation. 'config' overrides the suite's benchmark config (configs/toy100/constraints_simple_regularization.json with reg_arm a_r1r2 as the host marker); the same keys map 1:1 onto the ring tasks' particlegan recipe. 'recipe' overrides the released K3P recipe fields (particlegan.get_recipe() defaults) on every host. 'critic' is 'k3p' (the package K3P penalty/optimizers) or 'simple_B_cap3'. Noise off = input and output instance noise 0 from step 0; constant LR = lr_floor = network_lr_floor = 1.

k3p_stock.formulation: K3P as released on develop: RpGAN + K3P penalty/EMA anchor/spike guard + A2, input noise .5->0 and output noise .029, cosine LR decay (net floor .01 over a 1600 horizon, prior floor .05), Adam (0,.999)

k3p_stock_oldinit.formulation: calibration: k3p_stock with no particlegan.init call anywhere (constructor init on ring too). native/toy/hold/shift already use constructor init in this suite, so only the ring tasks differ from k3p_stock

k3p_stock_ams.formulation: k3p + ams: k3p_stock with AMSGrad on every optimizer

k3p_nonoise.formulation: k3p_stock (LR decay, Adam) with no instance noise

k3p_nonoise_ams.formulation: k3p_stock LR decay + AMSGrad, no instance noise

k3p_const.formulation: K3P constant LR (floors 1), Adam, no instance noise (baseline for the constant problem)

k3p_const_ams.formulation: k3p constant ams: constant LR (floors 1) + AMSGrad, no instance noise

simple_B_cap3.formulation: simple-critic winner B_cap3: wgan + R1(1) + secant to nearest real (10, t .5) + cap-all (10, c=3); critic Adam (0,.9), critic LR x.5, no guard/EMA anchor, A2 off; RpGAN G loss; no noise, constant LR

ab_noanchor.formulation: ablation of k3p_const_ams (constant LR + AMSGrad, no noise): EMA anchor term off (reg_anchor_weight 0); inert at constant LR (s==1), bit-exactness check

ab_noguard.formulation: ablation of k3p_const_ams (constant LR + AMSGrad, no noise): critic spike guard off (d_guard_ratio 0)

ab_noA2.formulation: ablation of k3p_const_ams (constant LR + AMSGrad, no noise): A2 latent-row damping off (latent_damping_max_rate 0)

ab_nodirect.formulation: ablation of k3p_const_ams (constant LR + AMSGrad, no noise): direct-particle response off (gain False, betas = G's (0,.999))

ab_prior1.formulation: ablation of k3p_const_ams (constant LR + AMSGrad, no noise): prior LR multiplier 2 -> 1 (prior LR = G's)

ab_r1only.formulation: ablation of k3p_const_ams (constant LR + AMSGrad, no noise): penalty = R1 on reals only (RMS units), fake one-sided cap dropped

ab_caponly.formulation: ablation of k3p_const_ams (constant LR + AMSGrad, no noise): penalty = one-sided RMS cap (kappa 1) on reals and fakes, no R1

ab_absunits.formulation: ablation of k3p_const_ams (constant LR + AMSGrad, no noise): penalty in L2 units: ||g_r||^2 + relu(||g_f|| - kappa)^2 (no 1/d, 1/sqrt d)

k3p_simple.formulation: k3p_simple: k3p_const_ams minus every component whose removal cost no suite pass or ring stability: EMA anchor/EMA critic term off (reg_anchor_weight 0; inert at constant LR), direct-particle response off (gain False, betas = G's). Keeps AMSGrad, constant LR, no noise, R1+fake one-sided RMS cap, spike guard, A2, prior LR x2
